Application Support Engineer (L2)

Keep our production platform healthy. You will own L2 incident response for
our customer billing and logistics applications, run root-cause analysis on
recurring problems, and maintain the scripts and runbooks the on-call rota
depends on. This is a support and maintenance role, not feature development.

Requirements:
- 2+ years in application or production support
- Strong SQL for investigating data issues
- Linux administration and Bash or shell scripting
- Incident management with a ticketing tool such as ServiceNow or Jira
- Familiarity with ITIL processes

Nice to have:
- Monitoring and logging tools (Splunk, Nagios, CloudWatch)
- Oracle or PL/SQL
- Python scripting for automation
- Windows Server and Active Directory
